scope: Independent static review of the four-stage owned supervisor only; worker correctness is reviewed separately. No actual import/render/operation launched by this reviewer.

checks.fixed_stages: Only import, verify, render and inspect; fixed Blender command for import/render and fixed D Python -I -B command for verify/inspect. No arbitrary command or stage path.
checks.identity_and_review: Exact starting commit/branch, pinned helper, complete candidate Python source-set/hash review, plan/log/prior importer audit binding, installed importer source hashes and Blender binary pins.
checks.predecessors: Every required predecessor worker must PASS and its owned host must PASS with the exact worker-receipt digest; direct predecessor files including inspected.blend and host receipts are watched before/after.
checks.render_headroom: Before any render marker, measured import process and Job committed-memory peaks must each be <=5GiB, leaving at least1GiB under the unchanged6GiB cap.
checks.resources: Original pinned helper enforces available RAM >=12GiB and free disk >=2GiB before marker and live during the worker.
checks.ownership_and_caps: JobObject process and aggregate Job memory limits are both6GiB; exact binary GO is sent only after job attachment.
checks.deadline_and_exit: 180-second execution deadline; owned tree must settle naturally inside it. PASS requires no forced cleanup, verified empty owned tree and measured process/Job peaks <=6GiB.
checks.exclusive_outputs: Stage output, attempt marker and host receipt must all be absent; exclusive output creation and no overwrite/retry.
checks.preservation: PASS requires unchanged watched source/prior-output byte hashes, sizes and modification times.
checks.private_runtime: Private scratch/user paths and CPU device environment; Blender uses background/factory startup/disable-autoexec and four threads.
